svg.title: KaizenFlow — detailed build and review workflow
svg.desc: Six stages: Frame, Build, Review, Fix, Merge, Finish. Three review depths, conditional second review, exact-head merge, stop conditions, reviewer contract, and retrospective. Cards within a stage describe work or alternatives, not separate agent handoffs. Existing PRs skip Build. Every stop reaches Finish.
svg.text: KaizenFlow
One context builds and fixes · fresh review by depth · one script merges · a lesson on every exit
01 FRAME
Choose the depth by the cost of a mistake.

g.text: Task: build, then review. Existing PR: go

The same context builds and fixes.

g.text: Work on a branch. Use a worktree if the
primary checkout is dirty or in use.

Run targeted tests during the work.
Run the full repository check once before
the first push. Then CI is the proof.
PR body: goal, acceptance criteria, safety

svg.text: 03 REVIEW
Choose one route. Bind every independent report to the current head SHA.
